annotations.title: Draft a Brand Profile From a Website

description: Read a client's website and fill in most of their brand profile automatically. Takes up to a minute or two. The result is a DRAFT: review it with get_brand_profile, correct it with set_brand_profile, then confirm. This is the fastest way to get a new client ready for a May run. Needs the May plan and a Mako customer connection.
name: draft_brand_from_website
